_source.describes: The hexcrawl Landmarks generator: its five d20 axes.
_source.status: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Games Omnivorous.
_source.rationale: A landmark is the thing you see from the next hex; a location is the thing you walk into. They share four axis names and nothing else — separate tables, separate field paths — so that either can be rewritten without disturbing a lock saved against the other. Every entry is original to this project.
